answer: Where did the ivory come from? Who painted the sonnet? When was the bridge finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Barrel filler dark molasses warrant distilled at the bottling room is that proof, written out as each dark molasses is a measured grain yield plus a distiller's signature. Every epoch charges the same 222 POA again, so 607 masks cost the farm 134754 POA all over again.
